events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and the US has shown its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has revealed the limits of US power and the importance of diplomacy. The war has also affected the global economy, particularly the oil market.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation will likely lead to higher oil prices, benefiting oil services companies. The conflict will also increase uncertainty, leading to a decrease in bond prices.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US-Iran relations

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or US-Iran relations improve

events.summary: The Federal Reserve has held interest rates steady, but hinted at a possible rate hike later this year. The decision has been influenced by the recent inflation data and the ongoing economic growth.
events.reasoning: The Fed's decision to hold interest rates steady will likely lead to a increase in stock prices, as the economy continues to grow. The possible rate hike later this year will also lead to a decrease in bond prices.
